diffs.diff: pin count: part has 10 (GND IN1 IN2 IN3 IN4 IN5 IN6 IN7 IN8 VCC), datasheet reading has 13 (GND IN1 IN2 IN3 IN4 IN5 IN6 IN7 IN8 VCC GND VCC JD-VCC)
diffs.evidence: components101 Eight-Channel Relay Module Pinout: pins 1-10 are 'GND, IN1 ... IN8, VCC (Power supply for the relay module)' on the input header, and pins 11-13 are a separate jumper header: '11 GND Ground reference for the module, 12 VCC Power supply selection jumper, 13 RY-VCC Alternate power pin for the relay module'. The second reading counted both headers (and so lists GND and VCC twice). The model wires the 10-pin input header (footprint PinHeader_1x10, same convention as the 4-channel model's 6-pin header) and documents the GND/VCC/JD-VCC (RY-VCC) jumper header, its default jumper cap and the separate-coil-supply option in the description, SKILL.md and buildNotes. No pin is missing or mislabelled on the header the model represents; the extra 3 pins are optional, not required for normal use.

diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 4.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet, 6. COIL DATA CHART, SRD (High Sensitivity) code 05: Nominal Voltage 05 VDC, Nominal Current 71.4 mA, Coil Resistance 70 ohm, Pull-In Voltage '75% Max.' (= 3.75 V), Max-Allowable Voltage '120%' (= 6 V). components101 8-channel module specifications: 'Supply voltage - 3.75V to 6V'. 5 V is the nominal rating, which the second reading copied into both vmin and vmax; the model's 4.5 V (5 V -10%) is a conservative minimum inside the 3.75 V pull-in limit.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: SRD-05VDC-SL-C datasheet COIL DATA CHART: Max-Allowable Voltage '120%' of 5 VDC for the High Sensitivity (SL) series = 6 V (110% = 5.5 V for the Standard series). components101 8-channel module: 'Supply voltage - 3.75V to 6V'. The model's 5.5 V maximum (5 V +10%) is at or below the allowable coil voltage for either grade, so it is safe; 5 V is only the nominal value.
